summary: RFC 8784 lets IKEv2 use a pre-shared post-quantum key so IPsec traffic stays safe from later decryption by a quantum computer. This document describes how to mix such preshared keys in the IKE_INTERMEDIATE and CREATE_CHILD_SA exchanges to strengthen post-quantum protection.

eli5.summary: Even if someone records secret messages now, a future super-computer should not be able to read them. This adds an extra secret shared in advance to make that harder.
